profiles.availability_status: Three exact repository-listed patient backgrounds; distribution by request, current inventory/leadtime/eligibility/terms not verified. Catalogs are not ready functional motor neurons.
profiles.positive_delta: Independent public repository route permits a multi-allele human model brief without depending on the mitofusin investigators sole T105M patient culture.
unresolved: No exactT105M patient fibroblast/iPSC catalog found in this bounded search.
No listed isogenic corrected control for these threeMFN2 lines in the examined panel; isogenic rows elsewhere concern MPZ/NEFL and cannot be borrowed.
No exact8015-P2 response or mature functional neuron/NMJ phenotype established in these catalog backgrounds.
Distinct line IDs are not a guarantee of unrelated families or independent disease mechanisms; confirm donor provenance when qualifying material.
profiles.qualification_gate_proposed: Authenticate line/allele and genomic integrity; establish reproducible mature neuronal/NMJ useful-function deficit and its genetic rescuability before randomizing drug. Compare at leasttwo MFN2 backgrounds and treat differentiation batches as nested replicates. Fibroblasts may provide a direct-reprogramming starting route; iPSCs provide a differentiation route; neither inherits the P2 phenotype.
profiles.T105M_bridge_proposed: If exact-allele anchoring is important, an engineeredT105M/WT isogenic pair in an independently available parental line is a separate model-development task; it is not a cataloged patient line and is not counted as an additional patient.
profiles.rank_change: Raises specificity of model route but does not raise efficacy tier, prove immediate stock or eliminate model qualification.

published_engineered_model.disease_perturbation: CRISPR targeting ATP2A2 exon1, selecting heterozygousframeshift and homozygousKO clones with matched control
published_engineered_model.functional_scope: HET/KO monolayer adhesion and calcium-handling deficits; HET organotypic differentiation abnormalities. Organotypic genetic model did not show complete acantholysis. Monolayer adhesion figure n=3 independent experiments, not three patients.
published_engineered_model.patient_origin: Engineered healthy line; not a Darier patient line.
published_engineered_model.availability_boundary: Original parental cells were a gift; BWH collection list and identity registry specify parent but present stock was not verified. Exact published mutant clones were not found in a standard public catalog. PX458 catalog is academic/nonprofit only, not available to industry.

independent_rebuild_routes.route: Catalog Ker-CT plus separately qualified heterozygous ATP2A2 engineering
independent_rebuild_routes.status: Cataloged immortalized human keratinocyte parent; a different line from N/TERT-2G
independent_rebuild_routes.scope: Apply publicly specified disease perturbation concept and qualify genotype, residual SERCA2, adhesion and stratification before drug testing. This is a proposed rebuild, not a validated reproduction.
independent_rebuild_routes.limitations: Immortalization/cell-background effects can alter the phenotype. Supplier lists research-use/commercial-use terms; catalog is not unrestricted development rights.

independent_rebuild_routes.scope: A separately designed partial ATP2A2 reduction/heterozygous engineering model would need functional qualification and retained differentiation.
independent_rebuild_routes.limitations: Finite lifespan and clonal engineering may complicate durable organotypic work. Chemical SERCA inhibition is a distinct perturbation and cannot replace a residual-target genetic model without validation.

profiles.qualification_gate_proposed: Use a heterozygous residual-SERCA2 model for the proposed activation hypothesis. First confirm sustained mechanical adhesion/barrier deficit plus a genetic-restoration positive control, without counting repeatedfields as donors. A null clone is a mechanistic boundary control, not the sole decisive efficacy model. Only then test post-deficit NDC9009 function at measured exposure.
profiles.rank_change: Rebuildable public model specification exists, but a ready disease-qualified catalog assay was not found. Patient fibroblast catalog entry is real and materially constrained, not immediately procurable. Keep model qualification as the first funding gate.
